scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.sql.yml down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.sql.yml up -d
scripts.db:seed: docker cp ./scripts/seed-demo-data.sql dc-cmdb-sql:/tmp/seed-demo-data.sql && docker exec -i dc-cmdb-sql /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P 'YourStrong!Passw0rd' -C -d cmdb_dev -i /tmp/seed-demo-data.sql
scripts.db:validate: docker cp ./scripts/check-schema.sql dc-cmdb-sql:/tmp/check-schema.sql && docker exec -i dc-cmdb-sql /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P 'YourStrong!Passw0rd' -C -d cmdb_dev -i /tmp/check-schema.sql
scripts.db:prepare: npm run db:start && npm run db:bootstrap && npm run db:seed
